info.name: House
info.description: Four on the floor: house, deep and Detroit house, minimal house, arpeggios and supersaws.

songs.name: Minimal House
songs.description: A minimal house song in F minor at 124 BPM, all synth sounds: intro, groove, break, groove and outro on the four Minimal House patterns. The open hat comes in halfway through the intro, the stab's filter opens over the first groove and throws its last chord into the echo every other phrase, kick and bass drop out for the last two beats before the break, the stab's echo runs away and the clap rises into the second groove, and over the outro the bass fades out and the hats thin out.

songs.name: Detroit Deep House
songs.description: A Detroit techno / deep house song in A minor at 125 BPM, all synth sounds: intro, groove, break, peak and outro on the four Detroit Deep patterns, over Am9, Am9, Dm9 and Em9. The bass's filter opens over the intro; the piano comes in after four measures of the groove and its filter opens; kick and bass drop out for the last two beats before the break; the strings swell over the break; in the peak the last stab of each phrase is thrown into the echo, and over the outro the bass fades out.

patterns.name: House
patterns.description: House, 1 measure: four-on-the-floor kick, snare and swung clap on 2 and 4, closed hats on 1, e and a, open hat on each &; 32nd snare roll on 4 and 16th cowbell every 3 to 8 passes.

patterns.name: Arp Showcase
patterns.description: Arpeggiator demo over house drums, 4 measures: one note per half measure that the arpeggiator fans out in 16ths: Am7 up, Fmaj7 down, Cmaj7 up and down, G7 up and down over two octaves.

patterns.name: Trance Supersaw
patterns.description: Trance over the house drums, 4 measures: a supersaw playing 16th arpeggios of Am, F, C and G with an octave jump twice a measure, and a warm pad holding the chords underneath.

patterns.name: House Upbeat
patterns.description: House, 1 measure: four-on-the-floor kick, clap on every &, open hats on each e and a, tom on 2 and 4, closed-hat pickups on 2& and 4; cowbell and crash accents every 4 to 8 passes.

patterns.name: House Pluck Bass
patterns.description: House with a plucked bass, 1 measure: C minor on every off-beat 8th with a short 16th pickup, root on 1&, 2& and 3&, E flat and F on 3&-4, the pickup falls to B flat.

patterns.name: Minimal House Intro
patterns.description: The intro of the Minimal House demo, 4 measures in F minor at 124 BPM, all synth sounds from the minimal presets: kick on every beat, ghost hats, a swung shaker, the rimshot's 3-3-2 and the open hat on the off-beats. The song's automation holds the open hat back for the first four measures.

patterns.name: Minimal House Groove
patterns.description: The groove of the Minimal House demo, 4 measures in F minor at 124 BPM: kick with two ghost notes, clap on 2 and 4, a rimshot in tape echo, ghost hats gated by probability, open hat and shaker on the off-beats, a pitched blip, a rolling off-beat bass ducked by the kick, a rootless F minor 9 stab on a dotted-8th tape echo and a low drifting pad (F minor 7, D flat major 7).

patterns.name: Minimal House Break
patterns.description: The break of the Minimal House demo, 4 measures in F minor: no kick and no bass, the pad comes up, a bell line in ping-pong delay answers the stab, whose echo runs longer; the shaker and the rimshot keep time and the clap builds up over the last measure.

patterns.name: Minimal House Outro
patterns.description: The outro of the Minimal House demo, 4 measures in F minor: the groove's drums with the bass on its root alone and the blip; the song's automation fades the bass and thins out the hats.

patterns.name: Dance
patterns.description: Dance, 1 measure: four-on-the-floor kick, clap on 2 and 4, open hat on each &, snare on 1e and 4a, sparse closed hats; tom pickups on 4 every 6 passes.

patterns.name: Detroit Deep Intro
patterns.description: The intro and outro of the Detroit Deep House demo, 4 measures in A minor at 125 BPM, all synth sounds: a 909 kick, swung hats and open hats, syncopated congas and the deep bass on the off-beats, following the roots of Am9, Am9, Dm9 and Em9.

patterns.name: Detroit Deep Groove
patterns.description: The groove of the Detroit Deep House demo, 4 measures in A minor at 125 BPM: the intro with a clap on 2 and 4 and electric piano stabs of Am9, Am9, Dm9 and Em9 on syncopated hits, in a dotted-8th tape echo.

patterns.name: Detroit Deep Break
patterns.description: The break of the Detroit Deep House demo, 4 measures in A minor: no kick and no bass, a warm pad and strings holding the four chords, the piano stabs on the first beat of each measure, the congas and a tambourine that builds in 16ths over the last measure.

patterns.name: Detroit Deep Peak
patterns.description: The peak of the Detroit Deep House demo, 4 measures in A minor at 125 BPM: the groove with a ride on the 8ths and the strings an octave up holding the chords, Detroit style.
